Windows of these applications are never listed or captured for AI tools, and they are blacked out in screenshots AI tools take. Names are application names or bundle identifiers; upper and lower case, spaces and ".app" don't matter.

Word, PowerPoint and Outlook insert into a new document, presentation or mail, or one that is open (the destination menu lists them). Excel inserts into the active sheet of an open or a new workbook. Outlook attaches the screenshot and uses the Email section's subject, To, CC and BCC; with “allow export in meeting items” it also lists the open meetings you organise and attaches the screenshot to the meeting. New Outlook can't be scripted. OneNote for Mac can't be scripted either: Notes takes its place (or use Open With). On a layout without a picture placeholder the screenshot is centred on the slide; a layout PowerPoint refuses gives a blank slide.
